description: 多格式文件工作台：图片（缩放/平移/棋盘底）、PDF、音视频、SVG 双模、字体、Markdown 预览、CSV/TSV 表格、JSON 折叠树、二进制 Hex 正则原生渲染（不再把图片当文本打开），文本类用 CodeMirror 编辑并 Ctrl+S 保存；左栏文件树 + 多标签 + Ctrl+P 快速打开，另带全工作区/指定目录的内容搜索与批量替换，同时向宿主文件树注册上述格式的查看器。与「源代码管理」联动：它的「在编辑器中打开」会在这里定位到行，每次保存后立刻回叫它刷新状态。
descriptionEn: Multi-format file workbench: native rendering for images (zoom/pan/checkerboard), PDF, video/audio, SVG (image or source), fonts, Markdown preview, CSV/TSV tables, collapsible JSON trees and binary hex dumps — no more opening a PNG as text. Text files open in CodeMirror with Ctrl+S save, alongside a lazy file tree, tabs, Ctrl+P quick open, and workspace-wide or directory-scoped content search with batch replace; the same viewers are registered with the host file tree. Source Control hands files over here (its “open in editor” button lands on the right line) and every save pings it to refresh.
